reason: The requirements settle the core design: one TextField on Product, edited on the dashboard update page, shown on the storefront PDP, with tests across all three repos. They explicitly decide against translation support (checklist item 8) and set no 250-character limit. They do not mention webhook payloads, CSV export, filter or search, or keeping the field out of cart, checkout and emails, and permissions are only implied through the existing mutations. No contradictions were planted, and I found none inside the requirements.
